description: United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) entries for United States. UN/LOCODE is a geographic coding scheme used worldwide for ports, airports, rail terminals, border crossings and other locations of trade/logistics relevance. Each entry includes the 3-letter location code, official name, subdivision, function classifier (port, rail, road, airport, postal etc.), IATA code where applicable, and coordinates.
